Vanessa / Stephanie / Elaine —

Thanks for the note. Below are concrete confirmations and the evidence types we can provide. I'll own producing the artifacts; target delivery is 4 business days (earlier if we can reuse the standard playbook outputs).

1) Region pinning
- Confirmation: Dedicated deployments can be provisioned into a single cloud region (we typically support ap-southeast-1 for APAC customers). The orchestration layer enforces scheduler placement and network endpoints are region-scoped. No customer tenant compute is scheduled outside the pinned region unless explicit cross-region failover is configured.

2) Data locality for persistent slices & snapshots
- Persistent snapshots and object stores used for tenant backups are kept in the pinned region by default. Cross-region snapshot replication is disabled unless the customer opts into a DR profile.
- Evidence: we can provide a per-tenant snapshot manifest listing S3/GCS URIs (region-coded), and storage ACLs showing region and bucket location.

3) Backups & replication controls
- Default: no automatic cross-region snapshots. Customers request replication via the Console/API.
- Controls: replication toggle, replication retention window, and explicit consent recorded in the deployment manifest.

4) Retention & purge procedure
- Defaults: user content retention 90 days for content indices; audit logs 30 days; backups retained per the customer's configured window.
- Purge flow: customer requests deletion -> orchestrator runs tenant evacuation -> snapshots are deleted -> object-store lifecycle removes remnants -> KMS key rotation may be scheduled depending on policy.

5) Deletion evidence we can provide
- Scrub log excerpt (redacted): entries showing deletion API calls, tenant ID, snapshot IDs, timestamps.
- Snapshot deletion manifest: listing deleted snapshot IDs and object paths.
- Storage access logs showing removal of objects (redacted paths OK).
- KMS entry showing key usage/rotation relevant to the tenant (where applicable).
- Signed attestation: a short GPG-signed PDF confirming the run and outcome.

Attachments we'll produce for HarborTech: redwood-dedicated-erase-playbook.pdf (redacted copy), per-tenant snapshot manifest, and a redacted scrub log sample. If HarborTech prefers DocuSign for the attestation, confirm and we'll generate the DocuSign envelope.

Open questions / caveats:
- If HarborTech requests forensic-level artifacts (full storage paths / object names), we will redact customer data and require an NDA/forensics agreement.
- For customers that enable cross-region DR, we will show explicit replication metadata and the replication control toggle in the deployment manifest.

I'll start assembling the artifacts and will post them to the SEC ticket (SEC-7192). ETA: EOD Thu (4 business days).

Cheers,
Rishi
